name: Quasicrystal Interference
desc: A sum of N evenly-angled plane-wave cosine gratings that interfere into a slowly shimmering aperiodic quasicrystal whose N-fold symmetry ratchets up section by section, rendered as spectral iq-cosine bloom, thermal false-color, cyan blueprint contours, sumi ink duotone, or a clustered-dot halftone screen.

scale.doc: fringe zoom / spatial frequency (more = tighter fringes)

symmetry.doc: N-fold order = number of plane waves (odd = aperiodic; section steps it up)

hue.doc: palette base hue (drifts over the section arc)

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100 = opaque bg)
